'''Gathus''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Tynquay sector/Legends|Tynquay sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The local [[Smashball/Legends|smashball]] team played against a team from [[Lafra]].
